summary: Foldline checks the landing page you are on for conversion problems. It reads the page in your browser and sends nothing to us.
reads: The layout, text, buttons and images of the current tab, after you click the icon.
Form field types and labels, never what is typed in them.
Load speed timings of this visit, from your browser.
stores: Settings on your computer: view, phone size, fold line switch and language.
In Mobile view, your window size for a short time, so Foldline can put it back.
never: Read what you type into forms
Send pages or results to any server
Keep a history of the sites you checked

perms.name: activeTab
perms.why: Read the current tab after you click the icon.

perms.name: scripting
perms.why: Run the checks and draw the fold line in that tab.

perms.name: sidePanel
perms.why: Show Foldline next to the page.

perms.name: storage
perms.why: Save your settings on your computer.

notes: The fold line is drawn on top of the page only while the panel is open, and removed when you close it.
Mobile view makes the window narrower and restores it when you switch back or close the panel. This needs no extra permission.
